text:
alex: Heads-up — cutoff for v1.8 is today 17:00 PT. Please get version bumps + changelog entries in and make sure CI is green. I'll run a build-green sweep at 15:30 PT. Ping here when your PR is merged or if you hit flaky tests. @ci-bot please mark the thread.
meera: Merged the version bump in #3456 and drafted the changelog entry under CHANGELOG/unreleased.md. CI is failing on an intermittant redis test: tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_eviction — rerun didn't help.
jamal: I saw that one. Opened a hotfix PR #3460 to quarantine the test with a TODO and link to the bug. Test reproduces non-deterministically on linux-gpu and ppc64. Test path: tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_eviction.
sara: Ok — for reproduction run locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_eviction -q` or try the job repro command from the job page. If it's non-deterministic we should mark flaky and create an issue for root cause analysis. I can run a targeted rerun on the failing job.
dmitri: Quick question on backports — do we want changelog and version bump backported to release-1.8 branch now or after rc tag? Suggest cut backport PR after green-sweep so we don't accidentally diverge.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Queued build #1287 for refs/heads/main (release-1.8 candidate). Initial matrix: linux-x86, linux-gpu, macos.
alex: Reminder: cutoff still 17:00 PT. If your PR merges after 15:30 we may not include it in rc1. Please add changelog lines to `CHANGELOG/unreleased.md` (one-liners) and link PRs. If anyone needs a production canary hold, say so now.
meera: Canary please — my feature toggles the new routing policy and I'd like a small smoke on canary group before we roll to all. cc @eng-oncall
jamal: @sara can you run the green-sweep across the linux-gpu pool ~15:10? I'll keep an eye on that flaky and revert the quarantine if we get false positives. Also include the `--repro` flag on any reruns for logs.
sara: Yep I can do 15:10. Command I'll run: ```./scripts/ci/green_sweep.sh --pools linux-gpu,linux-x86 --tag release-1.8``` I'll report back with job links.
ci-bot: build #1287 started. Job linux-gpu/pytest-ints -> running.
alex: If the sweep passes I'll merge the changelog PR and tag `v1.8.0-rc1`. If anything flakes we'll hold the tag and triage first thing tomorrow morning.
ci-bot: UPDATE: build #1287 status -> all jobs passed ✅. Green sweep complete. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/1287
alex: Merging changelog now and tagging `v1.8.0-rc1`. Thanks everyone — closing the cutoff. If you need the backport PR, @dmitri and I will cut it and link here.
dmitri: I'll open the backport PR to release-1.8 with the same changelog lines and link it here.
meera: Thanks — I'll kick off the canary smoke once tag is live and report perf/latency metrics in #eng-sre.
ci-bot: Note: quarantined tests list updated: tests/integration/test_cache.py -> quarantined until 2024-06-01. Please file a tracking issue if you need extended quarantine.
